# githubai documentation

> Every document in this repository, one line each: start with the root README, adopt with getting started, and see AGENTS.md for how to work here.

New to GitHubAI? Read [getting-started.md](getting-started.md), then [configuration.md](configuration.md). The workflow contract and the label taxonomy under [reference/](reference/) are generated from the source files by `python3 tools/gen_reference.py`.
